Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Classic Leather Throw Pillow - 18 x 18 Inch, Brown
Colors: Brown
Imported This gorgeous leather throw pillow is made from 100% genuine leather. The brown hide is a delight to the senses and speaks of old-world, traditional class and sophistication. 18"L x 18"W Pieced 100% leather; hidden zipper closure Pillow cover and insert Spot clean only.
